# PanditJiAtRequest
> Book verified pandits online for Puja, Havan, Satyanarayan Katha, Griha Pravesh & all Hindu ceremonies. Doorstep service across India with live video proof.

## Main sections
- Book Pandit Online -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/: Schedule verified pandits for home ceremonies across India
- Puja Types -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/puja: Browse all Hindu puja and ceremony listings
- Categories -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/category: Browse ceremonies by type and occasion
- Chadhava (Temple Offerings) -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/chadhava: Send offerings to temples online
- Live Mandir Darshan -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/: Live temple viewing and remote blessings
- Free Consultation -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/free-consultation: Talk to a pandit before booking
- Blog -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/blog/: Puja guides, ceremony information, Vedic knowledge
- Join as Pandit -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/join-as-panditji: Register as a verified pandit
- Shop -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/shop: Puja items, idols, and religious products
- Kashi (Varanasi) Services -> https://panditjiatrequest.com/kashi: Special pujas at Kashi Vishwanath

## Key facts
- 25,000+ verified pandits across all major Indian cities
- Same-day puja booking available
- Live video calling for remote ceremony participation
- 11 languages supported (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Punjabi, English)
- Secure payments via Razorpay
- Free consultation before booking
- Live photo and video proof of all ceremonies
- ₹799 starting price for basic pujas
